plugs.name: Gambler's Dodge
plugs.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.

plugs.name: Triple Jump
plugs.description: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.

plugs.name: Golden Gun: Marksman
plugs.description:
Summon a precision flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Your Golden Gun deals massively increased precision damage, overpenetrates targets, and creates Orbs of Power on precision hits.

Benefits from being radiant.

plugs.name: Snare Bomb
plugs.description:
Throw a Smoke Bomb that attaches to surfaces and pings enemy radar, then detonates into a disorienting smoke cloud, weakening nearby targets. Targets within the smoke cloud take damage over time.

Upon deployment, makes nearby allies invisible.

plugs.name: Grapple
plugs.description:
Weave a grappling hook, and quickly pull yourself forward. Grappling to a Tangle immediately recharges your grenade energy.

During and shortly after grappling, your melee attack deals area damage and unravels targets.

plugs.name: Transcendence
plugs.description:
Achieve harmony by dealing damage with Light and Dark damage types in equal measure or by applying subclass buffs to your allies. Kinetic damage generates both Light and Dark energy.

While Transcendence is active, your grenade is replaced by a unique Prismatic grenade that deals both Light and Dark damage. Dealing melee damage while transcendent greatly increases your grenade energy regeneration, and vice versa. Defeating targets while transcendent extends its duration.

plugs.name: Hailfire Spike
plugs.description: [Grenade]  : Throw a device charged with [Stasis] Stasis matter and [Solar] Solar energy that attaches to surfaces or targets, then erupts into a slowing storm. After a short duration, the device ignites, creating a deadly scorching cyclone.

plugs.name: Threaded Specter
plugs.description:
Activating your class ability leaves behind a decoy woven from [Strand] Strand matter that draws the attention of nearby combatants.

After taking significant damage or when combatants approach, the decoy detonates, dealing damage and releasing Threadlings that seek out and attack nearby foes.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.

plugs.name: Ascension
plugs.description:
[Air Move]  While airborne, consume your class ability energy to summon your Arc Staff, propelling yourself upward and creating a burst of energy around you that amplifies allies and jolts targets.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.

plugs.name: Facet of Dawn
plugs.description: Powered melee hits against targets makes you radiant. Powered melee final blows make you and nearby allies radiant.

plugs.name: Facet of Courage
plugs.description: Your [Arc] Arc, [Solar] Solar, and [Void] Void abilities deal increased damage to targets afflicted with Darkness debuffs.

plugs.name: Facet of Purpose
plugs.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants either Bolt Charge, Restoration, Frost Armor, Woven Mail, or Overshield based on the damage type of your equipped Super.

plugs.name: Facet of Protection
plugs.description: While surrounded by combatants, you are more resistant to incoming damage. While transcendent, the effect is increased.

plugs.name: Facet of Ruin
plugs.description: Increases the size and damage of the burst when you shatter a Stasis crystal or frozen target, and increases the area of effect of Solar ignitions.

Armor configured for Guardians that take the word "impossible" as a challenge.

item.name: Void Resistance
item.description: Reduces incoming Void damage from combatants.
item.exact:
15% | 25% | 30% Damage Resist against Combatants.

Elemental Mods reduce Mod-Matching Elemental damage.
Sniper reduces damage from >30 metres.
Melee reduces damage from <5 metres.

Different Resist Mods, as well as other sources of Resist all stack multiplicatively with each other.

linesContent.text: Kills with Weapons matching your Grenade Element grant a Stack of Death Throes. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
Stacks decay one at a time over 8|7|6|5|4 seconds for the 1st|...|5th Stacks.
Grapple Grenade is uniquely tuned and receives an additive buff instead (170% at maximum stacks).
On Grenade Ability usage with active Death Throes Stacks, for 5 seconds:
Allies receive 'Feel The Flames' while within 20 meters of you.
'Feel the Flames' grants 10x Grenade Recharge Rate.
(Grenade Regeneration Rate Multiplier is applied after all additive Grenade Recharge Rate modifiers.)

subclass.description:
[Super]  : Conjure a hail of deadly woven needles.

After embedding themselves in the environment, the needles will re-weave into a host of Threadlings.

Threadlings you create will return to you and perch if they can't find any nearby targets. Damaging targets with your weapons or melee will send out perched Threadlings to attack.

Chain Arc Lightning from your hands to electrify targets with devastating streams of Arc Light that intensify over time. Casting Stormtrance creates a jolting shockwave underneath you.

Step between dimensions to subvert the laws of physics.

[Super Secondary]  : Teleport a short distance and release weakening seekers.

linesContent.text: Holding down the trigger cycles between the three power levels: Low, Medium, and High.
Cycle resets upon trigger release, and follows the order:
Medium for 0.5 seconds 🠚 Low 1s 🠚 High 1s 🠚 Medium 1.5s 🠚 Low 1.5s 🠚 Medium 2s 🠚 High 1.25s 🠚 Low 1.25s 🠚 Repeats
Cycle determines damage output, with Low|Med|High granting the following damage increases:
Collecting an Orb of Power grants 'Supercharged Battery' for 10 seconds and
the magazine. Additional orbs grant 10 seconds each, extending the duration up to 20 seconds. Buff can be activated while stowed.
Supercharged Battery sets the power level to High for the duration of the buff, and dealing sustained damage for 2 seconds applies
Scoring 25 Hits within ? seconds of each triggers an explosion around the target, dealing up to
weapon element-matching damage in an 8 meter radius.
Scoring 69 Hits against enemies within 5 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8% Super Energy. Hit counter persists through stow.
